label: Crime rate
unit: NIBRS crimes against persons + property per 1,000 residents
description: Reported crimes against people and property per 1,000 residents, from Utah's 2024 state crime report. Crimes against people include simple assault, so the rate runs higher than a count of serious violent crime. Millcreek, Holladay, Eagle Mountain, and Midway share a county or regional police agency's area-wide rate, and Bountiful uses 2023 data.
source: Utah BCI (DPS) Crime in Utah 2024 report, NIBRS Crimes Against Totals
